title: Canonical tensor-power restriction comparison preserves section powers
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], L any module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], s a global section and U an open. Let s_U be the inverse restrictionAppIso applied to the ordinary restriction of s. For every n≥0 and open V of U, the inverse power comparison P_(U.ι)(L,n) of [def-sc-tensor-power-open-restriction-comparisons], followed by the section isomorphism from [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], sends s_U^n(1) on V to s^n(1) on U.ι image V. No affine, invertible, quasi-coherent, nonvanishing or nonempty hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 01CD, lemma-tensor-product-pullback; Tag 01PW, restriction of section tensor powers in its proof. Read from https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CD and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PW.

proof.text: Induct on n in the constructed power comparison. The zero comparison is restrictUnitIso, whose inverse is the ring isomorphism and sends 1 to 1. In the successor, use tensorPowSectionOne_succ and the inverse pure-tensor formula for the tensor comparison to move the two factors separately. The inductive hypothesis handles the nth power. homOfGlobalSection_app_one and naturality of restriction identify the degree-one factor with s restricted to the image open. tensorPowSectionOne_succ then gives the ambient successor power.

proof_origin.place: Explicit restriction comparison argument by T1, expanding the functorial tensor-pullback comparison of Tag 01CD.

lean.statement:
theorem openRestrictionTensorPowIso_inv_section (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules)
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (U : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) (V : U.toScheme.Opens) :
    let sU : Γ(L.restrict U.ι, ⊤) :=
      (L.restrictAppIso U.ι ⊤).inv (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s)
    ((L.tensorPow n).restrictAppIso U.ι V).hom
        ((openRestrictionTensorPowIso U.ι L n).inv.app V
          (tensorPowSectionOne (homOfGlobalSection (L.restrict U.ι) sU) n V)) =
      tensorPowSectionOne (homOfGlobalSection L s) n (U.ι ''ᵁ V)
